nodes.title: Melencholic
widgets_values: I was just thinking about how things used to be, and its not that I want to go back exactly, its just... there was this feeling, this lightness, and I didn't appreciate it...

nodes.title: Afraid
widgets_values: Okay something's wrong, something is definitely wrong, I can feel it... did you hear that? That sound just now, that wasn't normal, we need to leave, I'm not kidding! Let's go!

nodes.title: Sad
widgets_values: I don't know, I just... I thought it would be different this time, you know? I really did. And its not even anyone's fault, that's the worst part, there's nobody to blame...

nodes.title: Calm
widgets_values: Yeah, no, its fine. Everything's fine. I looked at the whole situation and honestly its just not worth getting worked up about. It'll resolve itself one way or another. Some day...

nodes.title: Happy
widgets_values: Oh my god yes! YES! this is exactly what I was hoping for, I can't believe it actually worked! I've been trying to get this right for like three weeks and look at it! I can't believe it, finally, I got it!

nodes.title: Disgusted
widgets_values: That is... oh god, oh no, I can't even look at it, why would you show me that, who does that, what is wrong with you? Is there something missing in your brain? Were you dropped on your head?

nodes.title: Surprised
widgets_values: Wait... what? Are you... hold on, what do you mean its already done? I literally just asked you five minutes ago, there's no way, that's not possible! Just... how?

nodes.title: Angry
widgets_values: No! NO! absolutely not! I told you three times, I told you specifically not to do this and you did it anyway because you never listen! Absolutely never! You need to listen to me right now!
